events.what: Steinerberger proves a stability version of Jones' inequality L >= |∂Ω|/2 for opaque sets
Kiderlen and Pausinger improve the explicit lower bound for opaque sets of the unit square (excess over 2 improved by more than a factor of 3) and give a new explicit lower bound for the unit disc
Deng claims a general computational framework for Bellman's lost-in-a-forest problem, said to extend to opaque sets

judgement.doubts: Agree with the record. The stability result is qualitative and bounds nothing on its own; it is an input to the Kiderlen–Pausinger bound. The first explicit disc lower bound beyond Jones is still a bound, not a case (F3). Journal acceptance (Acta Math. Hungarica) is per search metadata only; irrelevant to a progress code.
